detail:
Decisions: Chose to ship 2.16.1 as a point release at its true cost (server tag + plugin 1.34.1 bundle rebuild + both version files + pre-tag adversarial review + both-scope plugin update) rather than folding the four fixes into W2/2.17.1 — the ingest-deletion defect loses committed history on every host that merges a conflicted record file, the field's tier-A merge queue produces exactly that input, and the validator is the one thing the field can wire into its drain job next week; precedents: 2.7.0 (field-defect point release), 2.15.0 (revert warning point release), each shipped after the same review practice
Findings: the server-startup spawn tests boot dist/index.js against this repo's cwd, so any new canonical gitignore entry lands in this repo's own .twining/.gitignore the first time those tests run after the change — expect a modified .twining/.gitignore after test/server-startup.test.ts, not a stray edit
summary: 2.16.1 Task 5: CHANGELOG entry (Fixed: ingest retention, unknown-subcommand exit 2, records/**/*.tmp gitignore; Added: validate-records); this repo's .twining/.gitignore picked up the reconciled entry
